premises.text: Parents of school-going children face a bundled set of major pains: school communication gaps, child safety/health, instant progress/behavior reports, in-person fee payment, and daily needs like uniforms and stationery
premises.evidence_span: we have shortlisted five major pain points that a parent faces with regard to their school-going children

premises.text: Two-way notification messaging between parents and teachers
premises.evidence_span: Two-way communication between parents and teachers

premises.text: Instant report cards delivered to parents in the app

premises.evidence_span: Third is GPS tracking. It's about the tracking system. So it's about security of the child

premises.text: Online payment gateway so fees can be paid without going to school
In-app e-commerce for uniforms and stationery delivered to the home
premises.evidence_span: fifth is e-commerce solution for all the daily needs of the child

premises.text: Go-to-market targets ~30,000 private mid- to upper-high-end Indian schools, aiming to enroll 300 in two years
premises.evidence_span: we are targeting a market of the private mid-high and upper high-end schools, which are 30,000 in number

value.text: Solve parents' school-related daily struggles through one School Bridge app
value.evidence_span: how are we actually solving the problem
